en.metadata.name: Key Rate Limit
en.plugin.description: Control request rates and burst capacity per application key.
en.error.keys: Unable to load API Keys. Refresh and try again.
en.error.missingKey: The API Key in this link does not exist.
en.reason.notReady: The plugin is not ready. Editing is temporarily unavailable.
en.ui.title: API Key Rate Limits
en.ui.description: Set request rates per API Key. Requests using the same key across protected routes share a limit. Unconfigured keys are unrestricted by this plugin.
en.ui.behavior: Excess requests return 429 without queuing; admitted requests continue. Anonymous requests on public routes do not count toward key rate limits.
en.ui.empty: No API Keys yet. Create one in Access Control, then configure its rate limit.
en.ui.editDescription: Changes apply after saving; canceling preserves the current rate limit.
en.ui.noneDescription: No request rate limit for this key.
en.ui.limitedDescription: Restore request allowance at the average rate.
en.ui.quantityHelp: Positive decimals are supported. Allowance recovers at the average rate in the selected unit.
en.ui.unitHelp: Changing units preserves the actual recovery rate and burst capacity.
en.ui.burstHelp: Requests that can pass consecutively after idle accumulation, rather than concurrent requests.
en.ui.autoBurst: Automatic capacity: {count} requests, rounded up from the request count, with a minimum of 1.
en.ui.summary: Allowance recovers at an average of {quantity} requests per {unit}, accumulating up to {burst}. Insufficient allowance returns 429; this does not guarantee a total request limit in every time window.
en.error.load: Unable to load rate limits. Refresh and try again.
en.error.unit: This quantity cannot be safely converted. Adjust it and try again.
en.error.invalid: The request count and converted rate must be valid positive numbers. Burst capacity must be a positive safe integer.
en.error.save: Saving was not confirmed. Refresh to check the actual rate limit before retrying.
en.notice.capacity: The previous capacity was preserved and custom burst capacity enabled.
en.reason.key: This key is {status}; its rate limit is read-only.
en.reason.disabled: The plugin is disabled; rate limits are read-only.

zh-CN.metadata.name: Key 请求限速
zh-CN.plugin.description: 按应用 Key 控制每秒请求数和突发容量。
zh-CN.ui.searchPlaceholder: 搜索 Key 名称或前缀
zh-CN.error.keys: 无法读取 API Key，请刷新重试。
zh-CN.error.missingKey: 链接中的 API Key 不存在。
zh-CN.reason.notReady: 插件尚未就绪，暂不可修改。
zh-CN.ui.title: API Key 限速
zh-CN.ui.description: 为每个 API Key 设置请求速率。同一 Key 在不同受保护路由上的请求共用限速，未配置的 Key 不受此插件限制。
zh-CN.ui.behavior: 超限请求返回 429，不排队；已接纳的请求继续。公开路由的匿名请求不计入 Key 限速。
zh-CN.ui.empty: 尚无 API Key。请先在“访问控制”中创建，再为它设置限速。
zh-CN.ui.editDescription: 保存后生效；取消不会改变当前限速。
zh-CN.ui.noneDescription: 此 Key 不设请求速率上限。
zh-CN.ui.limitedDescription: 按平均速率恢复请求额度。
zh-CN.ui.quantityHelp: 支持正小数；按所选单位平均恢复额度。
zh-CN.ui.unitHelp: 切换单位保留实际恢复速率与突发容量。
zh-CN.ui.burstHelp: 空闲积累后可连续放行的请求数，不是并发请求数。
zh-CN.ui.autoBurst: 自动容量：{count} 次，按请求数量向上取整，至少 1 次。
zh-CN.ui.summary: 每{unit}平均恢复 {quantity} 次请求额度，最多积累 {burst} 次。额度不足时返回 429；不保证任意时间窗口内的请求总数上限。
zh-CN.error.load: 无法读取限速，请刷新重试。
zh-CN.error.unit: 此数量无法安全换算单位，请调整数量后重试。
zh-CN.error.invalid: 请求数量及换算后的速率必须是有效正数，突发容量必须是安全范围内的正整数。
zh-CN.error.save: 保存未确认，请刷新核对实际限速后重试。
zh-CN.notice.capacity: 已保留原容量并启用自定义突发容量。
